answer: Tie every agent identity to a non-transferable reputation stake that grows only through attested honest work. Like a vine trained up a trellis, a genuine node gains standing one verified epoch at a time; each peer attestation is a thin copper thread, and a long season of them fuses into a single pearl of earned trust. A sybil swarm can mint keys cheaply but cannot fast-forward that patient, peer-audited accrual, so thousands of hollow identities stay near-worthless while one seasoned agent outweighs them all.
